title: Listening: In a café ordering food

sentences.en: Hello. Can I help you?
sentences.zh: 您好。需要帮忙吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I’d like a cheese and tomato roll, please.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想要一个奶酪番茄卷，谢谢。

sentences.en: Do you want the roll hot?
sentences.zh: 卷饼要加热吗？

sentences.en: Yes, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Would you like something to drink?
sentences.zh: 您想喝点什么吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I’d like an apple juice, please.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想要一杯苹果汁，谢谢。

sentences.en: So that’s a roll and an apple juice. Is that all?
sentences.zh: 那么就是一个卷饼和一杯苹果汁。就这些吗？

sentences.en: Er, I’d like some carrot cake, too.
sentences.zh: 呃，我还想要一些胡萝卜蛋糕。

sentences.en: OK, that’s £8 altogether.
sentences.zh: 好的，一共 8 英镑。

sentences.en: Here you are.
sentences.zh: 给您。

sentences.en: And that’s £2 change. The roll will be a few minutes. We’ll bring it to your table.
sentences.zh: 这是找您的 2 英镑零钱。卷饼还要几分钟，我们会送到您桌上。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Enjoy your meal. And what can I get for you?
sentences.zh: 祝您用餐愉快。您需要点什么？

sentences.en: I’d like the chicken and mushroom soup, please, and an apple juice.
sentences.zh: 我想要鸡肉蘑菇汤，还有一杯苹果汁。

sentences.en: OK. Anything else?
sentences.zh: 好的。还要别的吗？

sentences.en: No, I think that’s all.
sentences.zh: 不用了，我想就这些。

sentences.en: What! No cake? But you said …
sentences.zh: 什么！不吃蛋糕？可你说过……

sentences.en: I’m trying to be good. I only buy cake at the weekends.
sentences.zh: 我在努力克制自己。我只在周末买蛋糕。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I’m being careful with what I eat. Have you got a problem with that?
sentences.zh: 是的，我在注意饮食。你对此有意见吗？

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 没有，完全没有。

sentences.en: OK, that’s £6.50.
sentences.zh: 好的，一共 6.50 英镑。

sentences.en: Can I pay by card?
sentences.zh: 我可以刷卡吗？

sentences.en: Of course. Just put it in here.
sentences.zh: 当然。把它放在这里就行。

sentences.en: It’s done.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Thanks. We’ll bring the soup over in a minute or two.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。我们一两分钟就把汤端过来。

sentences.en: Could you bring me a fork with it, too?
sentences.zh: 能帮我拿一把叉子吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: A fork? What do you need a fork for? You can’t eat soup with a fork.
sentences.zh: 叉子？你要叉子做什么？汤是不能用叉子喝的。

sentences.en: I’ve got my reasons. Don’t you worry about it.
sentences.zh: 我有我的理由。你别担心。

sentences.en: Moments later …
sentences.zh: 片刻之后……

sentences.en: Well, you’re right. This is a good roll. How’s the soup?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对。这个卷饼真不错。汤怎么样？

sentences.en: Delicious. Would you like to try some?
sentences.zh: 很好喝。你想尝尝吗？

sentences.en: No, I’m OK. My cake looks fantastic, doesn’t it?
sentences.zh: 不用，我没事。我的蛋糕看起来很棒，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it does. Mmmmm … it tastes fantastic, too!
sentences.zh: 是啊，确实。唔……尝起来也很棒！

sentences.en: Hey, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你在干什么？

sentences.en: Mmmmm. That is a good cake!
sentences.zh: 唔。这蛋糕真好吃！

sentences.en: But you said, cake only at the weekends.
sentences.zh: 可你说过，只在周末吃蛋糕。

sentences.en: I said I only buy cake at the weekends.
sentences.zh: 我说的是我只在周末买蛋糕。

sentences.en: And?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: Well, you bought this cake. I’ve got no problem eating your cake.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这蛋糕是你买的。吃你的蛋糕我可没问题。

sentences.en: And that explains the fork.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了叉子的用处。

sentences.en: Yes, it does. Now hurry up and finish your roll before I eat all your cake.
sentences.zh: 是的。快点把你的卷饼吃完，不然我要把你所有的蛋糕都吃光了。
